claims.text: A Department of War release dated 18 March 2026 names Sean Parnell as 'Chief Pentagon Spokesman' in its own title: 'Statement by Chief Pentagon Spokesman Sean Parnell on ‘Strengthening the Effectiveness of Our Senior Service Colleges’'.
